title: Orchid Foods Form 8-K/A routine amendment
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K/A
Amendment No. 1
Explanatory Note
This Amendment No. 1 to the Current Report on Form 8-K filed on May 1, 2026, accession no. 0015151515-26-000001, is being filed solely to furnish a corrected Exhibit 99.1. This amendment corrects a typographical error in the exhibit caption and does not amend or update any other disclosure in the original Form 8-K. No other changes have been made.
Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.
